comment: A coronal mass ejection (CME) seen on 28-SEP associated with a filament lift off is expected to arrive in the first forecast period. Geomagnetic conditions are anticipated to be ACTIVE with chances of STORM G1 intervals. While analysis shows that the bulk of the 30-SEP CME will miss, there is a small chance we could see a weak glance around 3-OCT. A large trans-equatorial coronal hole (CH) is currently in Earth-facing position. The onset of its associated high-speed stream is expected to reach the Earth on or around 4-OCT.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
